Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 1007/2020

Dear Mr. Bhosale,

Thank you for meeting us on 24/03/2020 about your dispute with Srivastava Industries. As we understand it, the employer offered to settle.

Our advice is to negotiate a settlement of gratuity and notice pay. Please collect the salary slips and the gratuity calculation and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹44,60,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
